story.title: Our Story
story.content: Mineternoys was founded with a simple mission: to provide reliable automation tools for community-based game servers. We believe that server administrators should focus on their communities, not on repetitive technical tasks.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To build simple, scalable, and reliable automation solutions that empower community server operators worldwide.

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.content: We take a product-first approach, developing focused tools that do one thing exceptionally well. Our products are designed to work together seamlessly while maintaining clear separation and purpose.
